linearized_gravity.gauge_symbol: delta h_mn = k_m xi_n + k_n xi_m

constant_mode.finding: A constant volume/conformal mode is not generated by a periodic diffeomorphism. Equivalently, the integral of div(xi) vanishes on a compact manifold without boundary.

nonzero_mode.finding: Even at a nonzero Fourier mode the pure trace tensor is not in the image of the diffeomorphism symbol. Gauge fixing mixes trace and longitudinal components but does not supply a standalone Weyl quotient.

majorana_direct_sum_gate.finding: Dividing the metric integral by Diff(K) acts in the metric block. It multiplies the full partition function by a common gauge-volume/ghost factor and does not delete one vector from the internal Majorana fiber.

weyl_gate.matter_consequence: A Weyl transformation rescales fields by their weights; it does not select one distinguished real direction inside R24. At the zero-field background its linear gauge map has no rank-one Majorana image.
weyl_gate.wrong_sign_warning: Rotating the Euclidean conformal-factor contour changes the integration cycle. It is not a quotient and does not change a finite module dimension.

Ahat_gate.finding: The denominator 24 is the normalization of a characteristic class, not a count of Majorana components and not evidence for 24-1.

comparison_with_existing_rank_one_routes.generation_singlet_no_go: The written proof of 23 as 3*8-1 is not representation-consistent. If N_tr is the generation-singlet spinor field, its removal subtracts an entire internal module: eight real dimensions in the declared eight-real case, leaving 16, not 23. A rank-23 subspace can be obtained only by removing one specified vector from the full R24 module, but no such canonical vector is currently derived. Qcycle remains a valid positive reciprocal operator and its seesaw contraction remains algebraically correct, yet the heavy denominator and therefore R_nu return to conditional status.
comparison_with_existing_rank_one_routes.finding: The conformal route fails, but the previously constructed class-D defect still supplies a conditional one-real-dimensional kernel. It remains the only explicit route to a rank-23 complement.

no_go.statement: In the frozen 4D parent architecture without local Weyl gauge symmetry, conformal-factor treatment cannot turn R24 into R23. A rank-23 heavy module requires an operator acting in the Majorana fiber itself.
reopening_conditions: derive an exact local Weyl symmetry of the complete massive parent action
construct its BRST complex and a nonzero mixed gauge map into the Majorana module
prove that the quotient removes exactly one real Majorana direction rather than a common scale or full internal copy
or derive the existing rank-one class-D defect from the S2T action

scientific_verdict.negative: Criterion F.3 closes negatively for the conformal/gauge-volume proposal.
scientific_verdict.retained: The conditional topological-defect selector and its internally consistent R24-to-R23 complement remain available, pending parent-action derivation.
scientific_verdict.program_effect: The integer 23 cannot be justified by the Ahat denominator or by removing the gravitational conformal factor. Its status remains conditional on the Majorana defect or another explicit rank-one operator.
